def test_words_in_sentence():
    # All words with prime lengths are kept
    assert words_in_sentence("This is a test") == "is"
    assert words_in_sentence("lets go for swimming") == "go for"
    # Length 2 words are always included
    assert words_in_sentence("go home") == "go home"
    # Length 1 words are excluded (1 is not prime)
    assert words_in_sentence("a bb ccc dddd") == "bb ccc"
    # No prime-length words -> empty result
    assert words_in_sentence("four five") == ""
    # Composite-length words excluded, prime kept
    assert words_in_sentence("hello world") == ""
    assert words_in_sentence("i am here") == "am here"
    # Single prime-length word
    assert words_in_sentence("cat") == "cat"
    # Length 7 (prime) and length 11 (prime)
    assert words_in_sentence("seven77 pythonista") == "seven77 pythonista"
